description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers; sacrifice it to gain an extra turn.
Activate Hall of Heliod's Generosity by paying {1}{W} and tapping it, putting Second Chance from your graveyard on top of your library.
In your draw phase, draw Second Chance.
In your main phase, cast Second Chance by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.
